svg.title: Height, slope and change of slope: f(x)=x³−3x
svg.text: Same x in every panel; different vertical scales.

svg.aria-label: Original function, with its tangent at the selected input
svg.title: f(x) = x³ − 3x

svg.aria-label: First derivative, whose height equals the slope of the original function
svg.title: f′(x) = 3x² − 3

svg.aria-label: Second derivative, whose height equals the slope of the first derivative
svg.title: f″(x) = 6x

svg.text: x = −1: local maximum · x = 0: inflection · x = 1: local minimum
